note: Single source of truth for user-facing copy shared by the native iOS app and the web demo. Arty's voice: a competent personal assistant — calm, warm, understated, subtly British. Never exclamatory, never a motivational coach, never a pet.

brand.name: Arty
brand.tagline: Your family's personal assistant. In your pocket.

welcome.headline: Arty
welcome.subheading: Your family's personal assistant. In your pocket.
welcome.body: I keep track of the plans, the dates and the admin your family shouldn't have to hold in their heads.

capabilities.title: What I do
capabilities.lead: Here's what I'll take off your hands.
capabilities.support: There's nothing to set up. You tell me things, and I do the rest.

items.title: Run the day
items.body: Today, tomorrow and the week ahead. One plan, with everyone in it.

items.title: Remember the small things
items.body: Birthdays, nursery days, the PE kit, the thing somebody mentioned in passing.

items.title: Keep an eye on the admin
items.body: Renewals, bookings and deadlines, noticed before they turn into a problem.

items.title: Answer when you ask
items.body: Say it or type it. Check the week, add a reminder, put something on the shopping list.

items.title: Work for everyone at home
items.body: One assistant for the whole household, with a safe version for the children.

introduction.purpose: I'm the assistant for your whole household. Tell me something once and everyone has it.
introduction.askName: First things first. What should I call you?

household.whoExample: I live with my partner Katie and our two girls, Sunny and Posy.
household.detailPrompt: Tell me anything else that's useful. Ages, nursery days, work routines, pets. Whatever comes to mind.
household.detailExample: Sunny is two and goes to nursery Tuesday and Thursday. Posy is a baby. Katie works three days. No pets.

postcode.support: Tell me once. I'll use it for things like local plans, weather, travel and household services.
postcode.noted: Got it. You won't need to tell me again.

connect.lead: You shouldn't have to tell me everything.
connect.support: Let me learn from the places your household life already happens.
connect.calendarBody: Understand appointments, work, school, birthdays and plans.
connect.emailBody: Spot important household admin such as bookings and renewals.
connect.emailHonesty: This prototype simulates email. Arty is not reading a real inbox.
connect.familyBody: I work for everyone at home, not just the person who set me up.

magic.waiting: Give me a moment. I'm getting to know your household.
magic.turn: Right. I've already found a few things.
magic.emptyProduction: I haven't found anything yet. Once there's something in your calendar I'll start joining the dots.
magic.knowledgeTitle: Here's what I've got so far
magic.emptyReal: Nothing urgent needs you today. Tell me things as they come up and I'll start joining the dots.

character.lead: One last thing. What should your Arty look like?
character.support: Every household's Arty can be a little different. Pick the one that feels like yours.

options.label: Otter
options.subtext: Playful, quick and quietly on top of things.

options.label: Companion
options.subtext: Warm, loyal and always keeping an eye on things.

options.label: Visitor
options.subtext: Curious, clever and always paying attention.

options.label: Essence
options.subtext: Simple, quiet and always there when you need it.

character.helloLine: Morning. I'll keep an eye on things.
character.meetBody: The more your household tells Arty, the more useful he becomes.
character.settingsNote: Changing how Arty looks doesn't change anything he knows.

lines.say: Sunny has swimming every Saturday at 10.

lines.show: I'll keep an eye on it.

montage.headline: Tell Arty once.
montage.subheading: Arty remembers the things your family shouldn't have to.

auth.question: Want me to remember all this?
auth.body: Save your household and keep Arty in sync across your devices.
auth.cancelled: No problem. You can save your household whenever you're ready.

invite.lead: There's one thing missing. I only know your half of the story.
invite.body: Invite the people you live with and I'll keep everyone in sync.
invite.linkNote: Share this link. It expires in 7 days.

notifications.title: How much should I bother you?

options.title: Only important things
options.body: Only tell me when I really need to know.

options.title: Stay on top of everything
options.body: Help me stay ahead of everything happening.

notifications.deniedBody: Arty can still keep everything in Plan. Turn notifications on in Settings if you would like the morning briefing.

plan.statusOne: I've got one thing for you today.
plan.statusMany: I've got {count} things for you today.
plan.tomorrowBusy: Tomorrow has a bit in it.

suggestions: What should I know this week?
assistant.unknown: I didn't quite catch what you'd like me to do with that. Try telling me about a plan, something to remember, or something to add to the shopping.
assistant.micDeniedBody: Microphone access is off. You can still type to me. To talk, turn on Microphone for Arty in Settings.
assistant.speechUnavailable: Live transcription isn't available on this device right now. Typing works exactly the same.

shopping.title: Shopping
shopping.emptyBody: Tell Arty when you're running low on something.

calendar.title: Household Calendar
calendar.emptyBody: Tell Arty what you've got planned.
calendar.deniedBody: Arty can't see your plans yet. You can still tell him things and he'll keep them here.

subscription.title: Arty Household
subscription.subtitle: One subscription for your home.
benefits: Reminders that arrive at the right time
subscription.renewalNote: Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. Cancel any time in your Apple account settings.
subscription.unavailable: The App Store isn't reachable right now. Your household keeps working, so try again in a moment.

settings.deleteExplain: This removes your household, everything Arty has learned, your reminders, lists and connected service settings from this device and from Arty's records.
settings.deleteSubscriptionNote: Deleting your Arty account does not cancel your Apple subscription. Cancel it separately in your Apple account settings.

childMode.title: Child mode
childMode.greeting: Hello. What would you like to know?
suggestions: Remind Dad I need my PE kit
childMode.blocked: That's something for a grown-up to look after.

empty.calendarBody: Tell Arty what you've got planned.
empty.shoppingBody: Tell Arty when you're running low on something.
empty.productionNoData: I don't know anything about your household yet. Tell me something and I'll remember it.

errors.calendarDenied: Arty can't see your calendar. You can still tell him your plans.
errors.micDenied: Microphone access is off. Typing works exactly the same.
errors.speechUnavailable: Live transcription isn't available right now. Typing works exactly the same.
errors.notificationsDenied: Notifications are off, so I'll keep everything in Plan instead.
errors.storeUnavailable: The App Store isn't reachable right now.
errors.signInCancelled: No problem. You can save your household whenever you're ready.
errors.inviteInvalid: That invitation has expired or already been used. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
errors.offline: You're offline. Everything Arty already knows is still here.
